text:
Alex Chen: Heads up — competitor Nimbus just shipped an auto-routing fallback that swaps to smaller models when latency spikes. Saw the blog + demo: https://nimbus.ai/blog/auto-routing
Marta (PM): Saw it. Can we avoid reactionary parity chasing? Worth a quick sync to decide parity vs double-down on our differentiator (configurable cost/latency policies).
Samir Patel: Technically parity (basic auto-fallback) is straightforward: ~2w infra spike to wire routing policy into the scheduler + tests. Biggest risk is cache invalidation on KV for prefix-heavy workloads.
Priya Rao: Which customers actually asked for this? We should tie effort to customer impact.
Jordan Lee: Sales flagged 3 mid-market accounts asking for automated cost controls in RFPs last week. Not existential, but helps close renewals.
Marta (PM): Proposal: ship core parity (basic auto-fallback with safe defaults) in ~6w. Defer advanced policy UI and tuning to H2. Launch criteria: no >1% quality regression on eval set, p95 latency within current SLO, docs & migration guide.
Alex Chen: Concern: new policy surface increases config complexity. Can defaults be entirely opt-in for advanced tuning?
Samir Patel: Yes — we can make advanced routing flags opt-in. Basic fallback will be zero-config for users on hosted. Dedicated/private customers can opt into controls.
Priya Rao: I can draft a customer-facing note + migration FAQ. Need sample prompts and expected behavior cases.
Jordan Lee: For rollout and monitoring, add evals and tracing. Suggested rollout snippet for ops:
```
rollout:
  canary: 5%
  metrics:
    latency_p95: 200ms
    quality_delta: <=1%
```
Marta (PM): Good. Action: @eng scope dev effort + blockers by EOD Friday. Also list observable metrics we need from Console.
Samir Patel: Will scope. Blocking items: scheduler changes for preemption, one additional perf test harness, and a KV cache invalidation spike scenario to simulate — estimate 10 dev-days.
Alex Chen: If sales pushes, we can re-prioritize and pause one Optimize spike to free cycles.
Priya Rao: Noted, looping in @sales to surface urgency.
product-bot: Task created — #task-routing-parity assigned to Samir Patel.
Jordan Lee: Thanks all — quick 30m sync in 20 to align on tradeoffs. :thumbsup:
